briefing_ko:
- **[SBA Paycheck Protection Program](https://www.justice.gov/usao-edva/pr/eastern-district-virginia-joins-doj-fraud-division-sba-and-sba-oig-surge-takedown)** — $245M 사기, 허위 사업·급여 과장 대출 탈취, 암호화폐·부동산·차량 구매에 사용.
- **[BitBank](https://www.blockmedia.co.kr/archives/1141305)** (Bitcoin) — IRGC에 수억달러 비트코인 전송해 제재 회피망 구축, OFAC 제재 지정.
- **[Blockchain Dead Drops (BDD)](https://www.chainalysis.com/blog/etherhiding-blockchain-dead-drops/)** (Bitcoin, BSC, TRON, Aptos, Polygon, Ethereum) — OP_RETURN·스마트 계약에 C2 데이터 삽입·교차체인 릴레이·가짜 지갑으로 은폐.
- **소액** — Cadman $25K.
- **시사점** — 블록체인에 C2 데이터를 숨겨 전송하는 기법이 지속적으로 등장하고 차단이 어려움.
briefing_en:
- **[SBA Paycheck Protection Program](https://www.justice.gov/usao-edva/pr/eastern-district-virginia-joins-doj-fraud-division-sba-and-sba-oig-surge-takedown)** — $245M fraud, fake businesses and inflated payroll used to obtain loans, proceeds spent on crypto, real estate and cars.
- **[BitBank](https://www.blockmedia.co.kr/archives/1141305)** (Bitcoin) — transferred billions of dollars in BTC to IRGC, creating a sanctions-evasion network; designated by OFAC.
- **[Blockchain Dead Drops (BDD)](https://www.chainalysis.com/blog/etherhiding-blockchain-dead-drops/)** (Bitcoin, BSC, TRON, Aptos, Polygon, Ethereum) — embeds C2 data in OP_RETURN or contract state, builds cross-chain relays and phantom wallets to hide IP.
- **Smaller** — Cadman $25K.
- **Takeaway** — Threat actors keep using blockchain-based C2 channels that are hard to block.
